title: Non defect-stabilized thermally stable single-atom catalyst
authors: Rui Lang; Wei Xi; Jin-Cheng Liu; et al.
research_question: Can high-loading Pt single atoms remain thermally stable without pre-existing support defects?
catalyst_reaction: Pt single atoms on Fe2O3 and Fe2O3-doped supports; CO oxidation
supported_finding: At 2 wt% Pt, clusters appeared alongside isolated atoms; the stated theoretical maximum was about 1.5 wt% for 10 m2 g-1 Fe2O3.
locator: PDF page 4; cited Supplementary Fig. 8c-d is not in the supplied main-paper extraction.
limitation: Loading is support-area and anchoring-site dependent; broad transfer beyond Pt/iron oxide is not established.
discussion_question_1: Which evidence distinguishes defect trapping from reducibility-enabled metal-support interaction?
discussion_question_2: How can the active isolated-Pt population be verified operando?
evidence_note: Page-labelled text from the supplied original PDF.

title: A universal ligand mediated method for large scale synthesis of transition metal single atom catalysts
authors: Hongzhou Yang; Lu Shang; Qinghua Zhang; et al.
research_question: Can one ligand-mediated route make a broad SAC library at high loading and kilogram scale?
catalyst_reaction: Cr/Mn/Fe/Co/Ni/Cu/Zn/Ru/Pt SACs on carbon; Ni-SAC CO2-to-CO
supported_finding: Ni-SAC maintained CO FE above 90% from -0.7 to -1.5 V and reached 98.9% at -1.2 V versus RHE.
limitation: Catalytic validation is concentrated on Ni; equivalent utility and durability are not shown for every metal.
discussion_question_1: Which controls separate ligand-mediated isolation from nitrogen-content effects?
discussion_question_2: Which scale-up variable most threatens site uniformity?
evidence_note: Corrected from Figure 4 to Figure 6 using supplied page-labelled text.

title: High performance platinum single atom electrocatalyst for oxygen reduction reaction
authors: Jing Liu; Menggai Jiao; Lanlu Lu; et al.
research_question: Can Pt single atoms reduce Pt use while retaining ORR device performance and tolerance?
catalyst_reaction: Pt1-N/BP; acidic/alkaline ORR and acidic fuel-cell cathode
supported_finding: Reported acidic-cell power density up to 680 mW cm-2 at 80 C with 0.09 mgPt cm-2 cathode loading.
locator: PDF page 1; Figure 2f on PDF page 4.
limitation: The active-site assignment relies on ensemble evidence plus models rather than direct operando site counting.
discussion_question_1: Which operando method could directly test the proposed pyridinic-N-Pt1 site?
discussion_question_2: Does CO/methanol tolerance uniquely establish the proposed site?
evidence_note: Publisher erratum must be checked; its content is not inferred.

title: Reaction mechanism and kinetics for CO2 reduction on nickel single atom catalysts from quantum mechanics
authors: Md Delowar Hossain; Yufeng Huang; Ted H. Yu; William A. Goddard III; Zhengtang Luo
research_question: How do three Ni coordination motifs control CO2RR kinetics and HER competition?
catalyst_reaction: Ni-N2C2/Ni-N3C1/Ni-N4 graphene models; CO2-to-CO and HER
supported_finding: For Ni-N2C2 the predicted onset at 10 mA cm-2 was -0.84 V, with 98% CO FE and TOF 3903 h-1 at that potential.
limitation: Idealized computational sites and modeled solvation/kinetics require operando experimental validation.
discussion_question_1: Which predicted observable best discriminates the three motifs?
discussion_question_2: How sensitive are the predictions to local pH solvent field and heterogeneity?
evidence_note: Page-labelled text from the supplied original PDF.

title: Addressing the quantitative conversion bottleneck in single-atom catalysis
authors: Zhongxin Chen; Jingting Song; Rongrong Zhang; et al.
research_question: Can a robust SAC flow module overcome productivity and leaching constraints?
catalyst_reaction: Pt1-MoS2/graphite felt nitroarene hydrogenation; Co1-MoS2 sulfide oxidation
supported_finding: At 0.2 M, reported maximum aniline productivity was 5.8 g h-1 with TOF about 8000 h-1.
locator: PDF page 4; cited Supplementary Fig. 21 is not in the supplied main-paper extraction.
limitation: Bench-scale hours-long tests leave manufacturing-scale transport safety replacement and economics open.
discussion_question_1: Which result best separates intrinsic chemistry from mass-transfer enhancement?
discussion_question_2: Which scale-up quantity should be conserved first?
evidence_note: Separate 12 h stability evidence is Figure 4e, PDF pages 4-5.
